lines.text: The town square. Above it, the clock tower.
The big clock says 2:00.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: That's... not right. That clock is never wrong. It's THE clock.
Something rolls across the cobbles like a slow wave. Quilts. Pillows. Two sleepy eyes.

lines.speaker: curfew
lines.text: Up past bedtime.

lines.speaker: curfew
lines.text: That's my department.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: It's Curfew! It puts awake kids back to bed! It's very nice about it! That's the hard part!

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: It's Curfew.

lines.speaker: tadzio
lines.text: Bedtime is for other kids.

lines.speaker: curfew
lines.text: I put everyone to bed. Every night. Nobody ever... tucked me in.

lines.speaker: curfew
lines.text: Thank you, little night worker. Mmmh...
Curfew goes down like a dropped quilt.
Up on the tower, the big clock ticks. Once.
Curfew rolls away into the dark, grumbling softly.
Up on the tower, the big clock does not move.

lines.text: The square is very still.
Up on the tower, the big clock does not move.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Tadzio. The clock. Something's wrong with it. I think the hour is getting-

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: -no, wait, listen, the minutes, somebody's been-
Curfew is fast asleep. It snores in three-four time.
The clock tower. Its hands point at 2:00. They have pointed at 2:00 all night.
Still 2:00. Up there, it is always two.
The fountain is off. The water is perfectly still, like it's listening.
A bench. A good spot to watch a clock that doesn't move.
